verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents a global application launcher on Super + Space and a separate Omarchy Menu on Super + Alt + Space, so app launching is covered. Nothing shows that the launcher also searches files or settings. File search is only the terminal `ff` fzf alias scoped to the current directory, which is a different feature. Missing for 10: documented file search from the global launcher, settings search from the launcher, evidence of instant or unified search, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can search for files, apps, and settings instantly from a global search launcher

citations.quote: you can hit `Super + Space` to reveal the application launcher and `Super + Alt + Space` to open the Omarchy Menu.
